purpose: Semantic role taxonomy and review rubric; classification is confirmed by the reviewing agent

review: Current location and selection are clear
Hierarchy and labels support the task
Keyboard/back behavior follows the platform
Density matches neighboring navigation
Command grouping and importance are clear
Selection/context affects commands correctly
Overflow and resizing are deliberate
Icons, tooltips, and shortcuts follow established patterns

roles.purpose: A coherent group of editable values
review: Grouping and order match the task
Labels and help are legible and useful
Validation and error recovery are clear
Spacing, alignment, and control variants match equivalent forms

roles.purpose: A standalone input or tightly coupled input cluster
review: Label, value, help, and error are associated
Input mode and control type fit the value
Focus and keyboard interaction work
Text expansion and validation states fit

roles.purpose: Primary, secondary, or destructive task actions
review: Primary action is discoverable
Action hierarchy follows the existing system
Destructive effects and recovery are understandable
Disabled/loading/focus states are meaningful

roles.purpose: Repeated items with scan, selection, or navigation
review: Order and grouping support scanning
Selection and activation are distinct
Row density and type roles are coherent
Empty/loading/error and long-content states are handled
Headers and data align
Sorting, selection, and actions are discoverable
Numeric formatting and density are consistent
Narrow/overflow behavior preserves access

roles.purpose: Primary information about a selected item
review: Content hierarchy matches user decisions
Context and relationships remain clear
Type, spacing, and media treatment are consistent
Long content and missing data remain understandable

roles.purpose: Secondary information or editing tied to a selection
review: Relationship to selected content is clear
Resizing and dismissal preserve context
Controls use existing form/editor patterns
It does not compete with the primary workspace

roles.purpose: A bounded modal decision or task
review: Modality is justified by the task
Title, consequence, and actions are clear
Focus enters, remains, and returns appropriately
Escape/cancel, sizing, and platform conventions work

roles.purpose: Status, validation, progress, empty or error feedback
review: Status and next action are understandable
Severity is expressed beyond color alone
Announcements and timing fit the interaction
Tone and visual treatment match equivalent feedback

roles.purpose: Editorial, media, or custom task content
review: Composition supports the primary task
Reading order and hierarchy are clear
Brand expression fits the surrounding product
Content adaptation and accessible alternatives are considered
